name: tracks increasing and decreasing table maxima
input: overwrites of a current maximum across two tables
test:
index = TableMaxIndex()
index.set_cell('a', 'x', 3)
index.set_cell('a', 'y', 5)
index.set_cell('b', 'z', 4)
assert index.table_max('a') == 5
assert index.global_max() == 5
index.set_cell('a', 'y', 2)
assert index.table_max('a') == 3
assert index.global_max() == 4

name: handles duplicate maxima, deletions, and empty tables
input: two equal maxima followed by removals
test:
index = TableMaxIndex()
index.set_cell('a', 'first', 7)
index.set_cell('a', 'second', 7)
assert index.delete_cell('a', 'first')
assert index.table_max('a') == 7
assert index.delete_cell('a', 'second')
assert index.table_max('a') is None
assert index.global_max() is None
assert not index.delete_cell('a', 'missing')
assert not index.delete_cell('missing', 'cell')

name: rejects malformed keys values and unknown table reads
input: empty names, boolean values, and absent tables
